items.title: Toyota to cut more production abroad due to Iran war
Muslims begin the annual Hajj against a backdrop of war concerns
items.description: More than 1.5 million pilgrims have arrived in Saudi Arabia for the annual Hajj pilgrimage, one of the Five Pillars of Islam, against the backdrop of a tenuous ceasefire in the Iran war and related regional tensions.

items.title: Soldier killed in south Lebanon by Hezbollah drone, another seriously wounded
items.description: Sgt. Nehoray Leizer, 19, from Eilat, was driving armored personnel carrier when it was struck in the Bint Jbeil area; he is 10th soldier killed amid truce, 23rd since March 2 The post Soldier killed in south Lebanon by Hezbollah drone, another seriously wounded appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: US says Iran deal still possible, as Trump tempers expectations
items.description: Even though both Tehran and Washington have signaled progress toward reaching an agreement to end the war, US President Donald Trump told his negotiators on Sunday 'not to rush into a deal,' insisting that 'time is on our side.'

items.title: Oil prices fall amid mixed signals on US-Iran peace deal
items.description: Japan's stock market surges to record high on hopes of an end to US-Israel war on Iran.

items.title: War in Ukraine: Russia launches massive missile strike on Kyiv
items.description: Macron, EU’s Kallas condemn Russian attack on Ukraine with Oreshnik ballistic missile.

items.title: I survived a missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz, but my friend has not been found
items.description: Sunil Puniya was on his first sea job when a missile struck the oil tanker Skylight at the start of the Iran war.

items.title: Serbia: Police clash with protesters urging early elections
items.description: Officers fired teargas and stun grenades as tens of thousands rallied against President Aleksandar Vucic's government. The demonstration went ahead despite the state rail operator canceling trains to and from Belgrade.

items.title: Ukrainian Drone Attack Sparks Fire at Russian Oil Depot
items.description: Two people were wounded in an attack on Russia's fifth largest oil export hub in Novorossiysk, the local mayor said.

items.title: NATO Chief: Ukraine Must Have What It Needs to Defend Itself
items.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said continued support for Ukraine is central to the alliance’s security, as ministers discussed Kyiv’s battlefield needs and Russia’s attacks on civilians. items.title: Ukraine: UN alarmed by reports of deadly strike on dormitory in occupied Luhansk
items.description: The United Nations voiced alarm on Friday over reports of an overnight attack on a vocational school and dormitory in the town of Starobilsk in Ukraine’s Luhansk region which killed and injured multiple civilians, including children.

items.title: Rubio Defends US Troop Decisions, Chides NATO At Foreign Ministers' Meeting
items.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended how Washington shifted military forces around the world amid confusion over whether a brigade-size contingent of US troops would be rotated out of Poland.
